title: Te Kereme mō te Mana Motuhake
intro: I ngā wā onamata, i ara ake tētahi tangata whai mana ki te whakahaere i tētahi whenua nui me ōna tāngata. I tohuhia te rangatiratanga o tēnei tangata e te whakapehapeha nui me te wero nui ki te mana atua. Kia rite ki te hura i te tuakiri o tētahi wairua nāna nei te mutunga iho i waiho hei akoranga pumau mō ngā whakatipuranga katoa.
clues: I pupuri ahau i te mana o tētahi emepaea nui, ā, ko taku kupu te ture.
I kī ahau ko ahau te atua nui rawa, me te tono kia karakiatia ahau e te hunga katoa i raro i taku mana.
I tukinotia e au tētahi hapori motuhake, i meinga rātou kia pononga, ā, i whakahaua hoki kia patua ā rātou pēpi tāne.
I tūtaki pinepine ahau ki tētahi karere whakaiti a te Atua, i mahi i ngā merekara mārama i mua i ahau me aku tohunga makutu.
I whakakeke tonu ahau i te pono, i whakapae i te karere mō te mahi makutu, ā, i whakatakoto whakaaro ahau kia whakangaromia ia me āna akonga.
I horomia mātou ko taku ope taua katoa e te moana i a mātou e whaia ana te hunga i wetekina mai i ōku ringa.

arabic: فَأَتْبَعَهُمْ فِرْعَوْنُ بِجُنُودِهِۦ فَغَشِيَهُم مِّنَ ٱلْيَمِّ مَا غَشِيَهُمْ
verse: So Pharaoh pursued them with his soldiers, and there covered them from the sea that which covered them, (20:78)
